opening: I've been hearing voices when there's no one there.
They started after my father died a week ago.
They talk about me in a negative way.
They urge me to harm myself.
I keep having unwanted thoughts that push their way into my mind.
I'm finding it hard to focus at work and in my studies.
My father died of lung cancer a week ago.
Losing my father has been very stressful for the whole family.

opening.text: I'm a student, and I've been having a really hard time since my father died of lung cancer just a week ago. It's been very stressful for the whole family. I've been hearing voices when there's no one there; they started right after he passed. They talk about me in a negative way and even urge me to harm myself. I also keep having unwanted thoughts that push their way into my mind. I've been feeling anxious, and I'm finding it hard to focus at work and in my studies.
